Follows Claude Code 2.1.332: the pane commands are now terminal-only, so `claude -p`, the Agent SDK, Desktop's Code tab, VS Code and Remote Control no longer list commands that open panes nobody there can see.

- **Terminal-only pane commands**: `/desk-diff`, `/desk-activity`, `/desk-tasks`, `/desk-pr`, `/desk-preview`, `/desk-context`, `/desk-sessions`, `/desk-monitor`, `/desk-fold` and `/desk-quote` register with `isTerminalOnly` (new in 2.1.332). In the terminal nothing changes. Elsewhere they drop out of the `/` menu, and a typed one answers that it isn't available there, instead of saying a pane opened when none could show
- `/desk-update` only runs the `claude` CLI, so it stays available everywhere
- desk-asana, desk-slack and desk-review mark `/desk-asana`, `/desk-slack` and `/desk-review` terminal-only the same way; desk-plan moves to 0.82.0 with only the version range raised

Needs Claude Code 2.1.332 or later.

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
